# AR Medias

> AR Medias is an IT services company founded on 1 January 2024 by Aryan Yadav in New Delhi, India. It builds websites, mobile apps, e-commerce stores, custom software, CRM and ERP systems, AI automation and machine learning, blockchain applications and cybersecurity services for businesses in India, the UAE, USA, Canada, Australia, Japan and China.

A longer plain-text version with every service, industry and market: https://armedias.com/llms-full.txt

- Address: N-48, 1st Floor, Scooter Market, Kirti Nagar, New Delhi 110015, India
